title: Center-crop a portrait
summary: Crop the center to a target aspect ratio and resize to the chosen dimensions. Default is a 100 by 200 portrait.
required_inputs: LoadImage: upload or select an image.
Center crop: set width and height to the desired ratio and output dimensions. Keep crop center.
limitations: Always centered; cannot choose a face or move the crop.
May resize after cropping; no padding, subject detection or AI.
Requires a working Comfy runtime with the named core nodes. No models or custom node dependencies.
